records.label: spacr.anndata_export.register_anndata_app#3
records.source: **No screen of its own, and none is wanted.** The app registers no ``factory``, so it gets the generic settings-driven ``AppScreen`` -- and every knob this module has is already a typed, tooltipped key in :func:`register_anndata_settings`, so that generic form IS the export dialog. ``defaults_module`` is what makes it appear: it tells ``settings_model`` to import this module before asking whether the key has defaults. The Run button runs :func:`run_anndata_export`, which is also what ``spacr-run anndata_export`` runs -- an export is a batch step you want on the cluster after Measure, not an interactive tool.
records.context: **No application view of its own, and none is wanted.** The app registers no ``factory``, so it gets the generic settings-driven ``AppScreen`` -- and every knob this module has is already a typed, tooltipped structured-data name in :func:`register_anndata_settings`, so that generic form IS the export dialog. ``defaults_module`` is what makes it appear: it tells ``settings_model`` to import this module before asking whether the structured-data name has defaults. The processing session button runs :func:`run_anndata_export`, which is also what ``spacr-run anndata_export`` runs -- an export is a batch step you want on the cluster after Measure, not an interactive tool.
records.translation: **Engin eigin forritaskjánýting, og engin er óskað eftir.** Forritið skráir engin ``factory``, svo það fær almennu, stillingamiðuðu ``AppScreen`` -- og hver hnappur sem þessi eining hefur er þegar týpufestur, með verkfærishjálp (tooltipped) nafn á uppbyggðu gögnum í :func:`register_anndata_settings`, svo sú almennu form er Útflutningsglugginn. ``defaults_module`` er það sem gerir það sýnilegt: það segir ``settings_model`` að flytja inn þessa einingu áður en spurt er hvort nafnið á uppbyggðu gögnunum hafi sjálfgefna stillingu. Vinnslufundarhnappurinn keyrir :func:`run_anndata_export`, sem er líka það sem ``spacr-run anndata_export`` keyrir -- útflutningur er lotuskref sem þú vilt á klasa eftir Mælingu, ekki gagnvirkt verkfæri.

records.label: spacr.chaining.PinStore#1
records.source: Auto-chaining is only welcome while it is filling in a blank.  The moment a user types a path of their own, that path is theirs: it survives a reopen, a restart, and every subsequent upstream run.  This is the record that makes that true, and it is deliberately *not* the settings dict — a settings dict cannot distinguish "the user chose this" from "we put it there".
records.context: Auto-chaining fills only blank values. Once a user enters a path, that path belongs to the user and survives reopening, restarting, and later upstream runs. This *separate record* stores that choice. The settings collection cannot distinguish "the user chose this" from "we put it there".
records.translation: Sjálfvirk tenging fyllir aðeins tóma reiti. Þegar notandi slær inn slóð, tilheyrir sú slóð notandanum og helst við að opna aftur, endurræsa og seinni keyrslur uppstreymis. Þessi *aðskilda skrá* geymir þá ákvörðun. Stillingasafnið getur ekki greint á milli „notandinn valdi þetta“ og „við settum það þarna“.

records.label: spacr.organelle_types#4
records.source: "Vesicular" is a CELL-BIOLOGY category -- a membrane-bound compartment that carries cargo -- and spots/ring/network/irregular is an IMAGE-APPEARANCE category: what the segmentation has to find. They do not nest, because the same biological family looks different at different sizes. A 200 nm transport vesicle is a diffraction-limited dot. A 2 um vacuole is a visible ring. Both are Vesicular.

records.translation: "Vesicular" er flokkur í FRUMU-LÍFFRÆÐI -- himnubundin eining sem flytur farangur -- og flekkur/hringur/netskipulag/óreglulegt er flokkur í MYND-ÚTLIT: það sem skurðurinn á að finna. records.label: spacr.deep_spacr.merge_predictions_into_db#1
records.source: Thin wrapper over :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, which is the one merge path Classify (CV) and Classify (ML) share. It used to be implemented here, keyed on ``basename(png_path)``, and collapsed repeated basenames with a plain ``dict`` assignment -- so a run over two source folders whose plates were both called ``plate1`` scored one plate with the other one's predictions and said nothing. The replacement keys on ``prcfo``, refuses a key that arrives with two different values instead of letting the last one win, counts every row it could not place, and runs in one transaction. See :mod:`spacr.predictions`.
records.context: Thin wrapper over :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, which is the one merge path Classify (CV) and Classify (ML) share. It used to be implemented here, indexed by ``basename(png_path)``, and collapsed repeated basenames with a plain ``dict`` assignment -- so a processing session over two source folders whose laboratory microplates were both called ``plate1`` scored one laboratory microplate with the other one's predictions and said nothing. The replacement is indexed by ``prcfo``, refuses a structured-data name that arrives with two different values instead of letting the last one win, counts every row it could not place, and runs in one transaction. See :mod:`spacr.predictions`.
records.translation: Þunnar umbúðir yfir :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, sem er sameiginlega samþættingarleiðin sem Classify (CV) og Classify (ML) deila. Það var áður útfært hér, skráð með ``basename(png_path)``, og samlagaði endurtekna grunnnafn með einfaldri ``dict`` úthlutun -- þannig að vinnslufundi yfir tveimur upprunalegum möppum þar sem rannsóknarstofa örplötur voru báðar kallaðar ``plate1`` gaf eina rannsóknarstofa örplötu með spár annarrar og sagði ekkert. Fyllingareiningin er skráð með ``prcfo``, hafnar nafn-grein sem kemur með tvær mismunandi gildi í staðinn fyrir að láta síðasta vinna, telur hverja röð sem hún gat ekki sett og keyrir í einni viðskiptaleysi. Sjá :mod:`spacr.predictions`.

records.label: spacr.qt.tutorial.engine#2
records.source: 1. Synthesize each Step's narration through Piper → WAV, know duration 2. Spin up the MainWindow (on real DISPLAY or under Xvfb) at 1920x1080 3. records.label: spacr.filters.annotate_from_gates#1
records.source: ``binary`` 1 when the object is inside EVERY chosen gate, 0 otherwise. The intersection, because that is what "annotate based on all the gates" means when the answer has to be one column. ``multiclass`` one class per observed combination of memberships. Only combinations that actually occur become classes -- enumerating all 2^n would offer classes with no objects in them, which no classifier can learn and every class-balance report would then have to explain.
records.context: ``binary`` 1 when the object is inside EVERY chosen data-selection boundary, 0 otherwise. The intersection, because that is what "annotate based on all the data-selection boundaries" means when the answer has to be one column. ``multiclass`` one class per observed combination of memberships. Only combinations that actually occur become classes -- enumerating all 2^n would offer classes with no objects in them, which no machine-learning classification model can learn and every class-balance report would then have to explain.
records.translation: ``binary`` 1 þegar hluturinn er innan ALLRA valinna gagna-valsvæða, 0 annars. Skurðurinn, vegna þess að það er það sem „merkja miðað við öll gagna-valsvæði“ þýðir þegar svarið þarf að vera í einni dálki. ``multiclass`` ein flokkun fyrir hverja staðfesta samsetningu aðildar. Aðeins þær samsetningar sem raunverulega eiga sér stað verða að flokkum – að telja upp öll 2^n myndi bjóða upp á flokka með engum hlutum í þeim, sem engin vélarnáms flokkunarlíkan getur lært og hvert skýrsla um jafnvægi flokka þyrfti þá að útskýra.

records.label: spacr.qt.hf_download#3
records.source: The classic Tk downloader in :mod:`spacr.gui_utils` uses a queue- based background thread. This module reimplements the same behaviour using Qt's threading + signals so the Qt GUI doesn't need to spin up a Tk mainloop just to see download progress.
records.context: The classic Tk downloader in :mod:`spacr.gui_utils` uses a work-list-based background execution unit. This module reimplements the same behaviour using Qt's execution concurrency + signals so the Qt GUI doesn't need to spin up a Tk mainloop just to see download progress.
records.translation: Hin klassíska Tk niðurhala í :mod:`spacr.gui_utils` notar vinnulista-bundna bakgrunnseiningu. Þessi eining endurhugbúar sömu hegðun með Qt framkvæmdasamkeppni + merkjum svo að Qt GUI þurfi ekki að ræsa Tk aðallykkju bara til að sjá framvindu niðurhals.

records.label: spacr.hits#6
records.source: **One row per gene. Enforced, not assumed.** The bundled ``toxoplasma_metadata.csv`` lists a gene once per transcript: 30 Gene IDs repeat between 2 and 32 times. Joined as-is, those genes came back two to thirty-two times and every consumer counted each copy as an independent hit. :func:`load_gene_metadata` collapses the annotation to one row per gene *before* the join and says how many rows it dropped, and :func:`join_metadata` asks pandas to ``validate="many_to_one"`` so a future annotation file that breaks the assumption fails loudly instead of silently multiplying the hits. :func:`build_hit_list` asserts the same invariant on its own output.
records.context: **One row per gene. Enforced, not assumed.** The bundled ``toxoplasma_metadata.csv`` lists a gene once per transcript: 30 Gene IDs repeat between 2 and 32 times. Framkvæmt, ekki gert ráð fyrir.** Bundna ``toxoplasma_metadata.csv`` listar genið einu sinni fyrir hverja umritun: 30 genanámskenni endurtaka sig á bilinu 2 til 32 sinnum. Þegar sameinað var eins og það var, komu þessi gen aftur tvö til þrjátíu og tvö sinnum og hver notandi taldi hverja eintak sem sjálfstaka skráningu. :func:`load_gene_metadata` sameinar skráninguna í eina röð á gen *fyrir* sameininguna og segir hversu margar raðir voru fjarlægðar, og :func:`join_metadata` biður pandas um ``validate="many_to_one"`` svo framtíðar skráningarskrá sem brýtur þessa forsendu mistakist háværlega í stað þess að margfalda skráningarnar hljóðlaust. :func:`build_hit_list` staðfestir sama ósveigjanlega regluna á eigin úttaki.
